<STBG 3,0><BGM 0,0,502><TALK 5><NAME 10><CHAR 5,1,7,0,8><CV 5,1>Foh-foh-foh.
What is it?

<TALK 1><NAME 1><CHAR 1,1,1,2,3><CV 1,5>We discovered something that seems amazing,
so we came to report!

<TALK 5><NAME 10><CHAR 5,0,7,0,0><CV 5,2>Let's see...
Won't you show me...
<ITEM COLLECTION08001,1,1><TALK 5><NAME 10><CHAR 5,0,7,0,1><CV 5,3>Oh, this is...

This is a beautiful mirror.
How was it embedded...

No, the rock's cross-section is a mirror.
I've heard of mirror stone, but never this.

And the pattern below...
this disc is like a sundial...

Yes, by reflecting in the mirror
one reads the time!

Telling time not by shadow but by light -
a type I've never seen...

"Sunlight on the disc tells the hour;
 the mark comes and goes, lighting all time"

<CV 5,4>Mm, it matches the words on the tablet.
This is surely the treasure.

I'll investigate the details later.
Drop by when you're near.

<TALK 1><NAME 1><CHAR 1,0,1,2,4><ITEM 0,1,0><CV 1,12>Thank you very much!
Please continue the investigation!
<CHAR 5,0,12,0,0><TALK 5><NAME 14><CV 17,17>It seems you found it safely...

<TALK 1><NAME 1><CV 1,67>Thank you for earlier!
Er, you are...
<TALK 5><NAME 14><CV 17,1>I am Solphine, serving as Lady Yuno's guard.
If I could be of any help, I am glad.

<TALK 5><NAME 13><CHAR 5,0,11,0,1><CV 16,3>Solphine!
Thank you for really coming!

Ah, these people escorted me here -
Hunter and Eliza!

<CV 16,17>Solphine is amazing!
The guard trial is very difficult,
and she became a guard the youngest ever!
<CHAR 5,0,12,0,0><TALK 5><NAME 14><CV 17,9>Both of you, thank you for Lady Yuno.

<CV 17,21>I was searching for Lady Yuno,
but to think she'd be in such a place...
<TALK 1><NAME 1><CV 1,4>No, I'm truly glad we found her.

<TALK 5><NAME 14>Lady Yuno is indispensable to the island.
That she was protected by people like you,
I am most grateful.

We will send a reward for the journey later.
We truly thank you for aiding the ritual.

<CV 17,4>Then, we shall take our leave.
Lady Yuno, let us go!
<CLS>
